candidates.change_summary: Assign tx.origin instead of msg.sender so owner differs when owned() is called through an intermediary.
Set owner to a fixed address instead of msg.sender, so the reported owner differs after any owned() call.
Invert the authorization check so non-owners can execute owned(), letting them overwrite owner to their address.
Change totalSupply decrement to increment so burn increases totalSupply instead of decreasing it.
Delete the totalSupply decrement so burn leaves totalSupply unchanged.

Move the totalSupply decrement before the balance require so a burn from an underfunded account succeeds in changing totalSupply (before reverting later is skipped since it happens before) rather than reverting with no state change.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may call burn, changing whose balance can be burned and thus totalSupply.
Change the burn deduction to an addition, so burning increases the caller's balance instead of decreasing it.
Remove the balance deduction, so a successful burn leaves balanceOf unchanged.
Burn one extra token (_value + 1) from the caller's balance.
Invert the onlyOwner check so only non-owners may call, making burn revert for the owner.
Freeze the caller instead of the target account.
Write the negation of the freeze flag to the mapping.
Always freeze the target regardless of the boolean parameter.
Delete the mapping update so frozenAccount is never written.
Set owner to the caller inside the modifier, letting any account become owner and freeze arbitrary accounts.
